description: Chromatic scales starting on every pitch class, both hands, ascending and descending, two octaves.

conventions.fingers: 1 = thumb ... 5 = little finger, positive for both hands
conventions.anchor: lowest note = tonic/root nearest middle C (MIDI 60; F-sharp ties go down to 54) for RH, one octave lower for LH; descending entries cover the same range from the top
conventions.startMidi: always equal to midi[0] (the top note for descending entries)
conventions.descending: exact reverse of the ascending entry (notes, fingers, alternatives), except melodic minor, whose descending entry uses the natural-minor notes and fingering
conventions.confidence: agreed = all consulted sources give this fingering; majority = sources disagree and the primary has more of them; tie = equal support, broken by the rule stated in the entry note; rule = derived from a documented fingering rule rather than a per-key printed table
conventions.alternatives: other fingerings printed by at least one cited source; a scorer should accept them
